* '''Mission''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Catalina.png]][[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/First Date|First Date]]
* '''Location''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar TheTruth.png]]U Get Inn Motel, Angel Pine, Whetstone
|}

After the cut-scene, get to the farm in Flint County to steal the Combine Harvester. The survivalist movement living there will try to shoot you with country rifles, so be careful. As you drive the Combine Harvester back to the Truth, a truck follows you with a guy with a country rifle shooting you, so you may want to take him out before carrying on. Once you arrive at the Truth's farm, with the Combine Harvester intact, you complete the mission.

== Rewards ==
* '''Respect''': +5
